@ a par in a branch that is not taken is not evaluated: the index is out of the table for k = 3
render par_in_plain_branches.in_a_branch sr=0x41000000 params k=3 in x=[0x3e800000 0x3f000000]
render par_in_plain_branches.in_a_branch_of_block sr=0x41000000 params c=false k=3 in x=[0x3e800000 0x3f000000]
render par_in_plain_branches.in_an_arm sr=0x41000000 params k=3 in x=[0x3e800000 0x3f000000]
@ a par in a branch is evaluated on the samples where the branch is taken
render par_in_plain_branches.in_a_branch sr=0x41000000 params k=1 in x=[0x3e800000 0x3f400000]
render par_in_plain_branches.in_an_arm sr=0x41000000 params k=1 in x=[0x3e800000 0x3f400000]
@ a part of block in a par of a branch decided at block is written when the condition holds
render par_in_plain_branches.in_a_branch_of_block sr=0x41000000 params c=true k=1 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000]
@ a par on the right of && or || is evaluated only when it is reached
render par_in_plain_branches.on_the_right_of_and sr=0x41000000 params k=3 in x=[0x3e800000 0x3f000000]
render par_in_plain_branches.on_the_right_of_or sr=0x41000000 params k=3 in x=[0x3e800000 0x3f000000]
@ a par on the right of && or || gives the value when it is reached
render par_in_plain_branches.on_the_right_of_and sr=0x41000000 params k=0 in x=[0x3e800000 0x3f400000]
render par_in_plain_branches.on_the_right_of_and sr=0x41000000 params k=1 in x=[0x3e800000 0x3f400000]
render par_in_plain_branches.on_the_right_of_or sr=0x41000000 params k=0 in x=[0x3e800000 0x3f400000]
render par_in_plain_branches.on_the_right_of_or sr=0x41000000 params k=1 in x=[0x3e800000 0x3f400000]
